name: offersmith-openresume-runner
description: Dependencies of the optional OpenResume layer of the ATS check. pdfjs-dist and @reduxjs/toolkit are pinned to the versions in OpenResume's own package-lock.json (3.7.107 and 1.9.5, not the newest releases): the layer must run the parser as OpenResume runs it. The parser imports an initial-state constant from a redux slice, hence the toolkit. The tar override only clears an audit finding: tar is reached through pdfjs-dist's optional canvas dependency, whose install script never runs (install.sh uses --ignore-scripts).
